stages.title: Story: chapters 1-4 and the finale
stages.why: Start with the campaign and let the story trophies come to you: every chapter and mission entry is on the critical path, so there is no reason to detour. The one bit of housekeeping that matters is a manual save just before the final mission, which keeps free roam open for cleanup. Two of the hidden trophies come from story choices, so keep a separate save before major decisions.

stages.title: Strangers and freaks
stages.why: Stranger and freak chains start showing up as each district opens. A chain only counts once its final job is finished, and some characters stop appearing after the story moves on, so see through anything you begin. Eight completed strands earn the silver, while Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret each have a trophy of their own.

stages.title: Activities and collectibles
stages.why: This is the long grind: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, every Top Fun venue, 20 different race wins, meditation spots, 100 WAiNK locations, three card sets, 100 vehicles, full map exploration and 50 challenges. Work district by district and keep your own tallies, since the in-game stats can lag behind what you have actually done.

stages.title: Partner and crime set-pieces
stages.why: These need a partner at your side or a particular wanted level, so batch them into one session: the four-star escape, three shops hit without losing the heat, five vaults, the armored truck, the silent jewelry job, one illegal operation per gang, Combat Focus kills and the melee drive-by.

stages.title: Money, property and world secrets
stages.why: Bankroll the garage purchases and shopping with laundering and heists, then sweep up the scene-specific hidden trophies — the VCIA departure, the Rhino, Ocean Beach, the showroom exit, the bowling alley, the second-attempt one and the secret-event one — while the world is quiet.

stages.title: Platinum cleanup
stages.why: Compare the in-game completion percentage with this checklist and finish whatever category is short; the 100% gold and the platinum then arrive together.
